consensus_findings.description: none: WAIT policy is honored correctly. select_registry_lane (policy.py:391-392) returns _evaluate_wait before any lane selection or switch-attempt bound is consulted, and _handle_vendor_limit short-circuits with lanes=() so no registry lookup occurs. The orchestrator persists pause_state (paused, reason, paused_at, blocked_vendor, expected_resume_at from capacity_reset_at or retry-after) and returns False without calling _fail, so checkpoint.phase stays at the paused phase and current_item_id is retained. execute_roadmap breaks the item loop on pause, refuses redispatch while _pause_is_active, clears the pause once expected_resume_at has elapsed, and resumes via the existing mid-phase checkpoint branch. SWITCH still goes through the attempt bound and exact to_agent_id retry. test_wait_policy_persists_pause_and_does_not_retry_or_select_lane and test_registry_lane_selection_honors_wait_policy_without_selecting_lane cover single dispatch, empty registry calls, paused-then-resumed same phase, and pause cleared. Reported evidence (autopilot-roadmap 104, Ruff clean, OpenSpec 93/93) was not re-executed by this verifier because command execution was denied in-session.

none: Snapshot persistence failure is logged and durably audited with failure isolation. On persist_probe failure the structured error log is retained and VendorRegistryService.audit_probe_persistence_failure emits a vendor_probe_persistence_failed audit record via _audit_event with target_agent_id set to the exact lane, result {status: failed, reason: probe_persistence_failed}, and success=False; the reason is a fixed constant so no exception text or secret reaches the audit store. The audit call is wrapped in its own try/except inside the per-lane loop, so an audit-backend outage is logged and cannot stop sibling snapshots or the legacy transition loop that follows. test_snapshot_failure_is_audited_without_suppressing_siblings and test_snapshot_audit_failure_does_not_suppress_siblings_or_transition assert two persist_probe awaits, one audit await, the error log text, and the vendor.recovered transition in both failure modes; test_probe_persistence_failure_audit_identifies_lane_and_reason pins the audit payload shape. Satisfies spec scenario 'Snapshot write fails' (spec.md:96-100) and D10 non-secret audit scope. Reported evidence (watchdog/registry 75) not re-executed by this verifier.

none: Persisted pause_state is sanitized through the canonical roadmap-runtime sanitizer without altering in-memory policy decisions. _persist_policy_pause now assigns sanitize_dict(pause_state) (orchestrator.py:1383), reusing the same sanitize_dict that learning.py already applies to learning entries, so checkpoint and learning artifacts share one redaction contract. sanitize_string is extended additively: existing _SENSITIVE_PATTERNS (api_key, token, password, secret, env_var, base64, AWS, GitHub) still run first, and the new _PROHIBITED_STRING_PATTERN only adds redaction of embedded raw_prompt/raw_response/auth_header/session_token/credentials/env_value fragments, with hyphen/underscore tolerance and the same [REDACTED:<field>] marker convention as sanitize_dict's key-level redaction. Safe strings are unchanged (test_preserves_safe_content). The PolicyDecision object and the policy_decisions summary list are not sanitized, and test_wait_pause_sanitizes_adapter_reason_only_at_persistence_boundary asserts the raw reason survives in-memory while the checkpoint carries [REDACTED:token], [REDACTED:raw_response], and [REDACTED:api_key] in reason and blocked_vendor. Callers outside pause persistence (learning.py, supervise digest's private _sanitize_string) are unaffected or use a separate helper. Reported evidence (roadmap-runtime 150) not re-executed by this verifier.

none: Watchdog persist_probe failure remediation verified against vendor-registry Snapshot write fails and D10. Per-lane persist failures remain ERROR-logged, then durable vendor_probe_persistence_failed audit records exact lane (target_agent_id), failed outcome, and stable non-secret reason probe_persistence_failed; audit-backend exceptions are caught/logged and do not stop sibling snapshot writes or legacy transition events. Evidence: focused snapshot/registry audit tests 3/3 green; related watchdog/registry suites green.

none: Checkpoint pause_state sanitization verified against Artifact Sanitization Validate sanitization on checkpoint writes. `_persist_policy_pause` assigns sanitize_dict(pause_state) via the canonical roadmap-runtime sanitizer before mgr.save; token/API-key patterns and embedded raw_response/raw_prompt fragments are redacted in persisted strings, while in-memory policy_decisions retain the unsanitized adapter reason; ISO expected_resume_at values remain parseable for resume. Evidence: roadmap-runtime 150 passed; focused pause sanitization tests green.
